Game Overview

Triangle Shooter is a shooter title where pilot your triangle starfighter through endless waves, amassing points in a vibrant arcade frenzy. Strategically choose powerful upgrades every few levels to enhance your ship and outlast relentless enemy assaults. Survive as long as you can in this exhilarating test of skill and strategy.
